Record Class InstructorRecruitmentsController.CourseRow

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.InstructorRecruitmentsController.CourseRow
Enclosing class:
InstructorRecruitmentsController
public static record InstructorRecruitmentsController.CourseRow(Long id, Long recruitmentId, String courseId, String enrollCode, String section, String title, String instructor, String days, String time, String room, Integer enrollment, Integer maxEnroll, String status, String summerSession, boolean removed, Integer allocation, Integer enrollmentEstimate, Double unroundedAllocation) extends Record
One section on the Courses page. When the viewer may not see the allocation columns the three allocation figures are null, and NON_NULL leaves them out of the JSON altogether, so the numbers never leave the server (not blanked: absent). The record has no stale, manual or version fields, which concern only admins.
